next.sub.en: Recent and newly discovered listings in the {date} collection. These are English-language public catalogs; viewer location and US demand are not verified.
next.sub.zh: 来自 {date} 采集的近期及新发现剧集。数据源为英文公开目录，尚未验证观众所在地区或美国市场需求。

next.window.collecting.en: One published day so far. Growth and first-seen dates appear after the next collection.
next.window.collecting.zh: 目前只有一天数据。下次采集后显示增长和首次出现日期。

next.fresh.en: {fresh} of {sample} listings are new by at least one observed reason.
next.fresh.zh: {sample} 部作品中 {fresh} 部至少有一项观测到的新作依据。

next.basis.en: New flags, lists, release dates and counters are read from the platforms; story types are tagged by Studio (taxonomy {version}).
next.basis.zh: 新作标记、榜单、上线日期和计数均读取自平台；题材由 Studio 标注（分类 {version}）。

next.tropes.sub.en: Share of new listings carrying each story type (multi-label), against its share of every listing. A lift above 1 means the platforms are launching more of it than they carry.
next.tropes.sub.zh: 各题材在新作中的占比（多标签），与其在全量作品中的占比对比。提升值大于 1 表示平台上新该题材的比例高于库存。

next.recipes.sub.en: Starting points based on recurring story types. Review the examples and develop your own premise; these patterns do not establish audience demand.
next.recipes.sub.zh: 根据常见题材组合提供构思起点。参考案例后发展自己的故事，这些模式不代表已验证的观众需求。

next.recipe.structure.en: {trope} appears with {pair} in {n} recent listings. Explore whether that combination fits your own story.
next.recipe.structure.zh: {n} 部近期剧集同时包含{trope}与{pair}。可探索这一组合是否适合你的故事。

next.recipe.structureSolo.en: Explore a story built around {trope}, using your own characters and setting.
next.recipe.structureSolo.zh: 围绕{trope}构思故事，发展自己的角色与背景。

next.recipe.format.en: Format on {platform}: median {eps} episodes, paywall at episode {pay}.
next.recipe.format.zh: {platform} 规格：中位 {eps} 集，第 {pay} 集起付费。

next.recipe.mine.zh: 剧库中同题材剧集：{n} 部

next.recipe.mineNone.en: Nothing in your catalog carries this story type yet
next.recipe.mineNone.zh: 你的剧库还没有这个题材

next.platform.sub.en: {fresh} of {sample} listings. Ranked by views added per day, within {platform} only.
next.platform.sub.zh: {sample} 部剧集中 {fresh} 部新上架。仅在 {platform} 内按日均新增观看排序。

next.platform.subNoHistory.en: {fresh} of {sample} listings. Ranked by prominence, within {platform} only.
next.platform.subNoHistory.zh: {sample} 部剧集中 {fresh} 部新上架。仅在 {platform} 内按显著度排序。

next.platform.none.en: No listing on {platform} is flagged new in this collection.
next.platform.none.zh: 本次采集中 {platform} 没有标记为新上架的剧集。

next.movers.sub.en: Views added per day since the previous collection, any listing, within {platform} only.
next.movers.sub.zh: 自上次采集以来的日均新增观看，不限新作，仅 {platform} 内比较。

next.overview.sub.en: Story types the US platforms are launching now, from the {date} collection.
next.overview.sub.zh: 美国平台现在正在上新的题材，来自 {date} 的采集。

next.overview.noData.zh: 尚无已发布的市场采集。

next.mine.yours.zh: 你的 {n} 部剧集含此题材

next.summary.mine.en: Your titles on a top-3 story type
next.summary.mine.zh: 你的剧集命中前三题材

next.tropes.subShort.en: Share is the percentage of recent listings with this story type. A listing can have several types, so shares can exceed 100% in total. A 1.2× ratio means its share is 20% higher than in the full catalog. Growth is the median change in each listing’s own platform counter across listings with a baseline; small samples may be unrepresentative.
next.tropes.subShort.zh: 占比表示近期剧集中该题材的比例。一部剧集可有多个题材，因此占比之和可超过 100%。1.2 倍表示其占比较完整目录高 20%。增长率是有历史数据剧集各自平台计数变化的中位数，小样本可能不具代表性。

next.board.ofNew.zh: 新上架 {sample} 部中的 {n} 部

next.tropes.oneLine.en: Compare the story types in recent listings and changes in their reported views.
next.tropes.oneLine.zh: 对比近期剧集中的题材及其平台播放量变化。
